results.name: Every first-time creation entry opens the dossier flow without creating supplier records
Drafts retain exact location and named respondent, and resume only under their preparer
Missing named contact and duplicate legal suppliers are rejected before mutation
Existing service onboarding pins both supplier identity and organizational location
Scoped preparation authority and explicit denies apply to intake and owner lifecycle commands
Owner confirmation and independent risk review are distinct assigned decisions
Risk approval creates real scoped assignments and document requests without activating service
Mandatory diligence cannot be silently removed and scoped reviewer permission is rechecked
Returned intake remains actionable through draft correction and preserves the prior submission
Legacy setup resumes as a dossier and cannot directly create an unreviewed service
A linked document becomes ready only after exact independent file approval
Expired, newer, or mismatched document sources cannot satisfy readiness
Activation requires accepted named responses, current reviewed documents and requirement decisions
Lifecycle commands bind the acting identity and do not accept a name-only reviewer
All onboarding screens render named assignments, readable locations and registered actions
